author: (Springer, 1950)

note.en: A large, deep-water requiem shark of the outer shelf and slope, listed by FishBase for Costa Rica but not known from any local record and beyond normal diving and handline depth.
note.es: Un tiburón grande de aguas profundas de la plataforma externa y el talud, listado por FishBase para Costa Rica pero sin ningún registro local y más allá de la profundidad normal de buceo y de cordel.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Carcharhinus altimus, Near Threatened

recWhy: No record on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in the file (general range or Costa Rica only).
